events.text: Her keel was laid down by Germaniawerft of Kiel as yard number 601.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Her keel was laid down on 16 September 1939 , by Germaniawerft , of Kiel as yard number 601 .

events.text: She was commissioned with Kapitänleutnant Heinrich Lehmann-Willenbrock in command.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She was commissioned on 14 September 1940 , with Kapitänleutnant Heinrich Lehmann-Willenbrock in command .

events.text: Lehmann-Willenbrock was relieved by Oberleutnant zur See Hans-Jürgen Hellriegel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Lehmann-Willenbrock was relieved in March 1942 by Oberleutnant zur See Hans-Jürgen Hellriegel

events.text: Hellriegel was relieved in turn by Oblt.z.S. Wilhelm Peters.
events.subject: self
events.quote: who was relieved in turn in March 1943 by Oblt.z.S . Wilhelm Peters .

events.subject: self
events.quote: In February 1944 , Oblt.z.S . Horst Willner took command

events.text: Willner turned the boat over to Oblt.z.S. Robert Rix.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Robert Rix in June of that year .

events.text: War correspondent Lothar-Günther Buchheim joined U-96 for her seventh patrol.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During autumn 1941 , war correspondent Lothar-Günther Buchheim joined U-96 for her seventh patrol .
